x: Wiseman took 2nd place, with 3rd hotly disputed between E.Hawkins and N.Berry both with 14 pts, Hawkins taking it on highest position, although N.Berry had competed in every event.
He and Edwin Hawkins represent London in the All-England meeting to be held at Cherterfield; Roger in the quarter and Edwin in the Long Jump.

Edwin Hawkins was another to excel in the London Schools' Championships, finishing 2nd in the Long Jump, and thus gaining his London badge. When representing London in the All England meeting he had the mis-fortune to record three 'no-jumps'.
